Put Trigger and Content under Root. Include Title and Description for accessible context. Use open and openChange when State controls visibility. The child slot lets a kit Button render the trigger element.

## Usage

```ts
import { dialog, components } from '@viewstem/svelte-ui/shadcn/dialog';
```

The set ID is `shadcn/dialog`. It [registers](../../registration/) 10 components for use in JSON.

### Example View

Register the `dialog` set and pass this JSON as `view` to `renderer.mount`.

```json
{
  "render": {
    "id": "settings",
    "componentRef": "shadcn.Dialog.Root",
    "slots": {
      "default": [
        {
          "id": "open",
          "componentRef": "shadcn.Dialog.Trigger",
          "inputs": {
            "text": "Open settings"
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "content",
          "componentRef": "shadcn.Dialog.Content",
          "slots": {
            "default": [
              {
                "id": "title",
                "componentRef": "shadcn.Dialog.Title",
                "inputs": {
                  "text": "Settings"
                }
              },
              {
                "id": "description",
                "componentRef": "shadcn.Dialog.Description",
                "inputs": {
                  "text": "Workspace preferences."
                }
              }
            ]
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

Open the settings dialog with the trigger and close it with Escape.

## JSON reference

Inputs without **Required** are optional. In a type, `?` marks an optional object field. **Default** shows a literal default declared by the Svelte wrapper. Other defaults are unspecified here and may come from the underlying component, the browser, or other inputs.

## Native types and composition

In Svelte, use `ComponentProps<typeof components.Root>` for the native prop type. Snippets, function props, DOM refs, and bindings follow the native types.
